LESSON: WEATHER AND ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment
Topic 1.1: Weather and its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Weather and its resources
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Weather and its resources
2. give Kenyan examples of Weather and its resources
3. practise a safe skill for Weather and its resources

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Weather and its resources

Teach
• Observe Weather and its resources in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Weather and its resources (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Weather and its resources.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Weather and its resources.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Weather and its resources.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Weather and its resources.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Weather and its resources: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Weather and its resources with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
